task: OTP/login brute-force protection; audit web auth client, login rate limiting, progressive delays, captcha/lockout behavior on failed attempts.

verified_source_anchors.description: Backend login brute-force guard check and 429 response structure
Backend login-otp verify endpoint action rate limiting
Backend LoginGuard blocked state and progressive lockout duration
Axios response interceptor error resolution and 429 rate limit metadata preservation
Login and OTP submission flow with rate limit and progressive delay handling

implementation_summary.auth_client_audit: Enriched http-client.ts response interceptor to preserve HTTP 429 status, retry_after_seconds body values, and Retry-After response headers on rejected client errors without breaking error.message backward compatibility.
implementation_summary.client_rate_limiting: Implemented apps/web/lib/auth-rate-limit.ts offering tiered progressive delays (0s, 1s, 3s, 5s, 30s), retry-after extraction, rate limit error detection, separate context accounting for login and OTP flows, and session storage persistence.
implementation_summary.progressive_delays_and_lockout: Integrated live countdown timer, cooldown banner, and form lockout in LoginPage, disabling inputs and the submit button during active cooldowns and server lockouts.
implementation_summary.security_challenge: Implemented AuthSecurityChallenge, an accessible, privacy-preserving client-side arithmetic verification challenge that triggers after 3 consecutive failures to block automated credential stuffing and OTP guessing.
implementation_summary.otp_brute_force_protection: Tracked failed OTP verification attempts independently with warning banners and delay escalation to prevent automated 6-digit guessing.
implementation_summary.state_reset: All failure records, cooldowns, and challenge requirements are completely wiped upon successful authentication.
